## Validation and limitations

The strategy retrieved all **19 screened development records** (100% relative recall against that set). This is not independent validation: there were no user seeds or matching prior-review benchmark. The Entrez-date cutoff is **2020-11-22**; no publication-date limit was applied.

The combined lifestyle/well-being block was AND-ed after testing. It retained all known records and reduced the exposure set from 98,285 to 15,705, but the final count exceeds the standard 10,000-record screening budget. A category probe found an eligible hygiene-habits study and prompted added terms; the probe budget was spent with an estimated residual category gap. The audit records these risks and the internal critic’s open objection: a generic `restrict*` term was overridden because testing it increased the final count to 118,555 without adding known records.
